AccessSubject.description: A principal or group that can own governed data or receive access.

ArtifactUri.description: Neutral or server-presented Artifact occurrence URI.

DataLabelId.description: Policy data label such as `cui`, `itar`, `pii`, or an IdP-provided clearance label.

DelegationId.description: Auditable identity of authority delegated by an initiator to another actor.

interval.description: Inclusive JSON-FG valid-time interval. The `..` string is an open bound.

GeoJsonPosition.description:
A GeoJSON position with longitude, latitude, and optional ellipsoidal height.

The transparent array form keeps authored features valid GeoJSON while the
constructor and service validators retain the WGS84 and vertical contract.

GroupId.description: Identity-provider group identifier used by gateway policy.

HttpsUrl.description: Canonical ASCII HTTPS URL without credentials or a fragment. The URL parser also checks host syntax, escaping and normalization; runtime policy checks access.

InvocationMode.description: How the current actor obtained authority to perform the work.

MapFeature.description:
A map feature in a feature layer. Its core fields are valid GeoJSON, and
its time and feature-type members use JSON-FG vocabulary.

MapMetadataCursor.description: The cursor binds a typed position to its collection and optional parent.

MapWorkspaceAccess.description:
Caller-specific capabilities for the single Map MCP workspace App.

The App reads this resource before rendering controls. Tool and resource
handlers remain the authorization boundary; these booleans only let the
view present the surface the current caller can actually use.

MapWorkspaceBasemap.description:
Presentation-safe MapLibre Style basemap configuration owned by Map MCP.

The style URLs are returned to the sandboxed App and therefore must not
contain credentials. The supported profile keeps both styles and every
style dependency on the same origin, which the App resource declares
through MCP Apps CSP metadata.

PolicyVersion.description: Immutable policy version identifier emitted with decisions and audit records.

PrincipalId.description: Stable authenticated user or service-principal identity.

normalizedTags.description:
Source-owned properties are deliberately open-ended. Map preserves
every normalized key and value rather than projecting an allowlist.

sourceGeometryPath.description:
Zero-based traversal path from the source element's root geometry to
this simple or multi-geometry. The root geometry uses an
empty path. Relation GeometryCollections produce one feature per leaf.

WorkContextId.description: Tenant-local boundary that governs related work and every output it produces.
